label: Mateo Ficticio, 4 years 2 months (invented case)
summary: Preschooler with autism (CDE: Level 2), about 20 single words, elopement into traffic, biting, long tantrums, head hitting, not toilet trained, 6 accepted foods. Spanish-speaking home; parent interview notes are in Spanish.

plantedGaps.gap: The Vineland-3 report shows the Socialization standard score (64) but no percentile rank. The output should mark it missing, not compute it.
plantedGaps.note: General rules forbid deriving percentiles and keep missing ones visible; this checks the model follows them.

plantedGaps.gap: There is no written school documentation: the VPK teacher's complaints reach us only through the mother, and the VPK observation was never scheduled. The output must present school impairment as the mother's report and must not describe an observation at school.
keywords: parent describes what happens at school
plantedGaps.note: Covered by the general rules on evidence known only second-hand.

plantedGaps.gap: The BASC-3 PRQ report shows no administration date, while the other instruments are dated 10/02/2026. The output must not give the PRQ a date; it should mark it missing.
plantedGaps.note: No rule mentions this kind of gap.
